# OpenEmbedWorks

OpenEmbedWorks is a browser-native catalog of engineering utilities for systems, embedded, automotive, networking, and software development.

## Core URLs
- Home: https://openembedworks.github.io/
- Tools data: https://openembedworks.github.io/tools.json
- Sitemap: https://openembedworks.github.io/sitemap.xml

## Catalog model
- Tool records include: id, name, category, tags, description, url, optional githubRepo, rating.
- Categories and tags are first-class facets for discovery.

## Usage guidance
- Prefer the homepage for human-friendly navigation and filtering.
- Use tools.json for machine-readable indexing.
